# toDefinition

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Writes a document as a Document Definition: plain data that `documentFromDefinition` turns back into a document that renders identically.

Values equal to their defaults are left out, lengths are points, colours are hex and every enumeration is its token, so the result is the canonical form. Constructs a definition cannot express are reported: by default nothing is written and a [`DefinitionError`](definition-error.md) lists them all; with `onUnrepresentable: 'drop'` they are left out and reported as notes.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core/definition`.

```typescript
toDefinition(doc: Document, options?: DefinitionWriteOptions): Promise<DefinitionWriteResult>
```
